senses.sense_definition: A curved flat wooden tool or missile that can be thrown so that it spins and returns to the thrower.

examples.text: He threw the <w>boomerang</w> across the open field, watching it circle back to him.
A traditional Australian <w>boomerang</w> was displayed in the museum case.

senses.sense_definition: A breakdancing move in which the dancer walks on their hands while keeping their legs held above the ground.

examples.text: The dancer impressed the judges by executing a flawless <w>boomerang</w> across the floor.
Learning to do a <w>boomerang</w> requires incredible upper body strength and balance.

senses.sense_definition: A type of curved martial arts kick.

examples.text: He caught his opponent off guard with a quick <w>boomerang</w> to the ribs.
The fighter trained daily to improve the speed and precision of his <w>boomerang</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A mechanical device attached to a stage followspot used to quickly change colored gel filters.

examples.text: The technician pushed the lever on the <w>boomerang</w> to switch to a warm red filter.
Make sure the <w>boomerang</w> is properly aligned before the theatrical performance begins.

senses.sense_definition: The premature return of an aircraft whose planned flight or mission was aborted.

examples.text: Engine trouble forced an unexpected <w>boomerang</w> only twenty minutes after takeoff.
The pilot recorded a <w>boomerang</w> in the logbook due to severe electrical failure.

senses.sense_definition: A cocktail prepared with rye whiskey and Swedish punsch.

examples.text: He ordered a classic <w>boomerang</w> at the vintage cocktail bar.
The recipe for a <w>boomerang</w> combines spicy whiskey with the sweetness of punsch.

senses.sense_definition: To backfire and produce an unexpected, harmful result for the person who initiated the action.

examples.text: Her aggressive political campaign might <w>boomerang</w> and cost her valuable votes.
The company's plan to secretly raise prices <w>boomeranged</w> when customers protested.

senses.sense_definition: To travel or move in a curved or looping path.

examples.text: The scared horse <w>boomeranged</w> through the trees and returned to the road.
The ball <w>boomeranged</w> along the curving boundary line toward the corner flag.

senses.sense_definition: To abort an aviation mission and return to base early.

examples.text: The squadron had to <w>boomerang</w> because weather conditions deteriorated rapidly.
After detecting fuel contamination, the pilot decided to <w>boomerang</w> immediately.
